facts.text: AgilentControl.py programs an Agilent 33600A arbitrary waveform generator by sending SCPI commands via TCP
UploadArb.py uploads a specified arbitrary waveform to the device and saves it to the device's memory
UploadArb.py opens the same 'TCPIP::<address>::INSTR' VISA resource
The control script queries '*IDN?' through the VISA session
After each macro line the control script queries 'SYST:ERR?' and treats a reply whose first two characters are '+0' as no error
The upload script truncates an arbitrary-waveform name to 12 characters, the maximum length allowed by the SCPI interface
The upload script computes the sample rate as 1 divided by the mean interval between the file's time bins
The upload script sends the waveform as a little-endian float block with pyvisa's write_binary_values
After the block upload the script sets the arbitrary sample rate, offset 0, the ARB function and the amplitude
The frequency-sweep macro selects the sine function and sets the frequency with 'SOURce1:FREQuency +50E+03'
The square-wave macro selects the square function and sets 20 percent duty cycle, 5000 Hz, 0.07 V high and 0 V low on channel 2
The triangle-wave macro selects the triangle function and sets 50 percent duty cycle, 40000 Hz, 0.50 V high and 0 V low on channel 2
A stored arbitrary waveform is loaded with 'MMEMORY:LOAD:DATA1' followed by 'SOURCE1:FUNCTION ARB' and 'SOURCE1:FUNCtion:ARBitrary'
The macro files switch the channel 1 output on with OUTPUT1 ON

operator_required.name: frequency
operator_required.reason: The clone states no frequency range: README.md:10 points to an external manual that is not part of the clone, and the macro files contain only example frequencies. The operator supplies the bound at deployment.

operator_required.name: amplitude
operator_required.reason: The clone states no output-amplitude range: UploadArb.py:16 has a pulse-height default and the macros show example voltages, neither of which is a device bound. The operator supplies the bound at deployment.

operator_required.name: offset
operator_required.reason: The clone only writes offset 0 (UploadArb.py:92) and states no offset range, so the operator supplies the bound at deployment.

operator_required.name: sample_rate
operator_required.reason: The clone computes the sample rate from the input file (UploadArb.py:52-54) but states no device range. The operator supplies the bound at deployment.

safe_state.description: channel 1 output switched off (OUTPUT1 OFF, the off form of the OUTPUT1 ON the clone sends); the amplitude, offset and waveform settings are left unchanged
